reply:
You're right — I can't promise it either, and I shouldn't pretend to. That uncertainty is real and it doesn't go away.

What I'd point out is that it cuts both ways: she might do the worried face, and she might not. You can't use either outcome to decide, because neither one is in hand yet. The only thing actually in front of you is whether sitting alone with the folder is better or worse than finding out which one she is.

And you already named the condition yourself — not alone. That's the toll for the not-alone part.
